description: The Dog in the Chinese zodiac: loyalty, fairness and protectiveness, its Earth element, years from 1970 to 2030, and its San He, Liu He and Liu Chong matches.
answer: In Chinese astrology, the Dog is the eleventh animal of the twelve-year cycle, with Earth as its fixed element and Yang polarity. It is traditionally associated with loyalty, fairness and protectiveness. Your animal follows the Lunar New Year of your birth, so early-year birthdays can belong to the previous animal.

sections.heading: The Dog in Chinese astrology
paragraphs: The Dog is the eleventh animal of the cycle and is usually described as loyal, honest and principled. Its branch, Xu, is linked with late autumn, and its fixed element is Earth. People born in Dog years are often portrayed as faithful friends with a strong sense of justice, ready to defend people and causes they believe in. The Dog is associated with integrity, responsibility and protectiveness. Descriptions also mention anxiety and pessimism: a Dog may worry about what could go wrong and be slow to trust new people. Many readings present it as one of the most dependable animals, valuing sincerity above all and offering steady support once its trust has been earned.

Many readers recognise the Dog in an instinct to defend people who are being treated unfairly, and in a habit of quietly checking that the people it loves are safe. As a Yang animal, its loyalty is active and outward-facing.

sections.heading: The Dog at work
paragraphs: At work, the Dog is often described as conscientious, fair and committed to doing the right thing. Law, social work, teaching, medicine, public service, security and advocacy are commonly mentioned, along with any role where integrity matters. A Dog tends to be a loyal team member and a principled leader. The traditional caution is worry and rigidity about principles: a Dog may become anxious under uncertainty or clash with colleagues it sees as unfair. Readings often suggest that people born in Dog years do best in organisations whose values they share, and that they benefit from separating real ethical concerns from general anxiety so that their sense of justice is directed where it matters most.

A Dog also tends to be a steady presence during difficult periods at work, the person who stays calm and keeps doing what is right. It often works best with leaders it can trust, and it may lose motivation quickly if it sees colleagues behaving dishonestly.

sections.heading: The Dog in relationships
paragraphs: In relationships, the Dog is usually described as devoted, protective and sincere, one of the most loyal partners in the zodiac. A Dog often shows love through steadfast support and honesty. Its classical allies are its San He partners, the Tiger and the Horse, and its Liu He secret friend, the Rabbit, while the Dragon sits opposite it in the six clashes. The common relationship friction is worry and defensiveness: a Dog may need frequent reassurance or become critical when it feels its trust has been tested. Partners who are honest, consistent and reassuring tend to find the Dog an unwavering companion through good and difficult times.

Friendships with a Dog tend to be long-lasting and deeply loyal. It is often the friend who turns up in a crisis and stays until things are better. It values honesty and consistency, and it may take a while to warm to new people before offering that steadfast loyalty.

sections.heading: Years of the Dog and their elements
paragraphs: Recent and upcoming years of the Dog are 1970 (Metal), 1982 (Water), 1994 (Wood), 2006 (Fire), 2018 (Earth) and 2030 (Metal). Each begins at Lunar New Year rather than on January 1, so people born in January or early February need to check the date: in 1970, for example, the Dog year began on February 6, and anyone born before that is a Earth Rooster. The element attached to each year comes from the ten-year cycle of heavenly stems, so a Metal Dog and a Water Dog share the animal's core character but differ in flavour. Separately, the Dog always carries Earth as its fixed element and a Yang polarity, which describe the animal itself. Because the five stem elements and twelve animals line up again only every sixty years, the Wood Dog of 1994 returns in 2054. The Chinese zodiac calculator on this site applies the Lunar New Year table from 1924 to 2044 automatically.

sections.heading: Growth edges for the Dog
paragraphs: The growth edge for the Dog usually involves trust and optimism. Traditional descriptions mention anxiety, pessimism, stubbornness about principles and difficulty forgiving. A Dog may also take on others' problems as its own responsibility. Practices that tend to help include questioning worst-case thinking, giving people a chance to explain before judging, and caring for itself as faithfully as it cares for others. The Dog's gift is loyalty, the ability to stand by people and principles when it matters. It tends to grow when that loyalty is balanced with openness, so that protectiveness feels like support rather than suspicion, and when the Dog allows itself to expect good things as well as prepare for bad ones.

In a Unified Reading, the Dog often adds a note of loyalty and principle to the wider profile, reinforcing a caring Life Path or Sun sign, or giving a more independent one a stronger sense of commitment. For anyone born in a Dog year, these growth notes are prompts for reflection rather than fixed traits.

faq.question: What is the Dog known for in Chinese astrology?
faq.answer: Loyalty, honesty, fairness and protectiveness. The Dog is often described as a faithful friend with a strong sense of justice, sometimes prone to worry.

faq.question: Which animals are traditionally best with the Dog?
faq.answer: The Tiger and the Horse share the Dog's San He trine, and the Rabbit is its Liu He secret friend. The Dragon is its Liu Chong clash and the Rooster its Liu Hai harm.

faq.question: Why is the Dog linked with guardianship?
faq.answer: Dogs have guarded homes and herds across Chinese history, so folk descriptions cast the Dog as a watchful protector: vigilant at the gate, devoted to its household and quick to bark at strangers. Modern readings translate that imagery into loyalty, fairness and a protective instinct.

faq.question: What years are the Year of the Dog?
faq.answer: Between 1924 and 2044 the Dog years are 1934, 1946, 1958, 1970, 1982, 1994, 2006, 2018, 2030 and 2042. Each starts at Lunar New Year, which falls between January 21 and February 20.

faq.question: Which animals are most compatible with the Dog?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Tiger and Horse share the Dog's San He trine and the Rabbit is its Liu He secret friend. The Dragon (Liu Chong) and the Rooster (Liu Hai) are the pairings readings treat as needing more care.
